summary.text: Justin Pence is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 33, which covers Page County, Shenandoah County, and parts of Rockingham and Warren counties.
Justin Pence has been a member since January 14, 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Justin Pence was born in Harrisonburg, Virginia, in 1977.
Justin Pence has a bachelor's degree in animal and poultry science from Virginia Tech, with a minor in economics.
Justin Pence's listed occupation is self-employed.

Justin Pence's listed memberships and affiliations include the Virginia Farm Bureau (state board of directors), the Shenandoah County Economic Development Council (chairman), Woodstock-Edinburg Community Baseball (president), and the Shenandoah County Agricultural Foundation (member).
The profile lists Jamie Pence as Justin Pence's spouse.
The House profile lists Justin Pence's committee assignments as Communications, Technology and Innovation and Courts of Justice.
